content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Amritsar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at IIM Amritsar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate post at IIM Amritsar is 11 September 2026. Ensure you complete the application process well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree with significant research experience from a recognized University or Institution. A Master's in Human Resource or a Ph.D. is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms where applicable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 26,000 to Rs. 35,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate position at IIM Amritsar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Research Associate position at IIM Amritsar must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position will primarily involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position at IIM Amritsar is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIM Amritsar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Amritsar is located in Amritsar, Punjab.
